answer: Each agent identity is bound to a TPM/SGX enclave and admitted only through zero-knowledge attestation; velvet is the enrollment state tree, grove the hash-anchor registry, and timber the consensus contract. Forging identities requires acquiring distinct sealed hardware and defeating attestation, while timber imposes an O(N^2) bonding curve: Sybil growth demands continuously provisioned silicon and quadratic capital, and invalid proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
